description: DOCK11 domain map with pathogenic truncating variant positions
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np, requests, pandas as pd, re

L=2073
domains=[("PH",165,272,"#8e44ad"),("C2 (DHR-1)",640,818,"#d68910"),("DOCKER (DHR-2, GEF)",1609,2036,"#c0392b")]
# ClinVar P/LP DOCK11-specific alleles (from iteration 1) -> approximate protein positions
plp=[("p.Ile1464fs","frameshift",1464),("p.Leu1299fs","frameshift",1299),("p.Ser1793fs","frameshift",1793),
     ("p.Tyr2012Ter","nonsense",2012),("p.Gln1252Ter (PMID 40274249)","nonsense",1252),
     ("c.392+1G>A (splice, ~p.131)","splice",131),("c.4582-1G>A (splice, ~p.1528)","splice",1528)]
cols={"frameshift":"#1f618d","nonsense":"#922b21","splice":"#148f77"}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.2))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,-0.12),L,0.24,color="#d5d8dc"))
for name,s,e,c in domains:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,-0.22),e-s,0.44,color=c,alpha=0.9))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,0,name,ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=9,weight="bold")
# ARM-repeat region (N-terminal, binds activated CDC42 per cryo-EM, residues ~66-126 noted by UniProt)
ax.plot([66,126],[0.32,0.32],lw=4,color="#2874a6")
ax.text(96,0.40,"66-126: activated-CDC42\nco-binding region",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#2874a6")

for i,(lab,kind,pos) in enumerate(sorted(plp,key=lambda x:x[2])):
    y=-0.45-0.13*(i%3)
    ax.plot([pos,pos],[-0.22,y+0.03],lw=1,color=cols[kind])
    ax.plot(pos,-0.22,"v",color=cols[kind],ms=6)
    ax.text(pos,y,lab,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7,color=cols[kind])

ax.set_xlim(-60,L+60); ax.set_ylim(-1.05,0.62)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("DOCK11 residue (UniProt Q5JSL3, 2073 aa)")
ax.set_title("DOCK11 domain architecture and ClinVar pathogenic / likely pathogenic truncating alleles\n"
             "Cryo-EM structures 22VD-22VG (PMID 42837459) show a U-shaped dimer: DOCKER binds nucleotide-free CDC42,\n"
             "activated CDC42 binds a distal armadillo-repeat site, a membrane-dependent positive feedback loop",fontsize=9.5)
ax.spines[["top","right","left"]].set_visible(False)
h=[plt.Line2D([0],[0],color=v,lw=3) for v in cols.values()]
ax.legend(h,cols.keys(),fontsize=7,loc="lower right",frameon=False,ncol=3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
